messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":8,"verses":[{"chapter":8,"verse":1,"text":"Behold, he upbraids us. Therefore let us return to our countries."},{"chapter":8,"verse":2,"text":"This man sits here in misery worm-eaten amidst an unbearable state of putrefaction, and yet he challenges its saving : Kingdoms shall perish and their rulers, but my Kingdom, says he, shall last forever\"."},{"chapter":8,"verse":3,"text":"Eliphaz, then, rose in great commotion, and, turning away from them in great fury, said: \"I go hence. We have indeed come to comfort him, but he declares war to us in view of our armies\"."},{"chapter":8,"verse":4,"text":"But then Baldad seized him by the hand and said :\" Not thus ought one to speak to an afflicted man, and especially to one stricken down with so many plagues."},{"chapter":8,"verse":5,"text":"Behold, we, being in good health, dared not approach him on account of the offensive odor, except with the help of plenty of fragrant aroma. But thou, Eliphaz. art forgetful of all this."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}
